text: Following a stroke, I have regular sessions with a physiotherapist who is very competent and patient. Thank you for everything.

Got recommended, to go there in January,  I had a trapped nerve in my back , after only 1 visit 100% better, will be 1 of the 1st places I visit again in May , cost of treatment 600 baht , bargain in my book .

Six months ago, I also had cervical spine pain. I went to a similar physiotherapy clinic in Phuket and the results were very good, so I found this place. This time, no improvement has been made, and the doctors' professionalism and physiotherapy equipment are almost ten years behind the last one in Phuket. The most frustrating thing was that I didn't recover at all after it was over, so I couldn't stand up, but there was no one to help me until I struggled to get up to pay. Very, very unprofessional!
Very good physiotherapy, very professional service and very friendly staff, totally recommended. For real

I'd really like to give 5 stars but the reason why I gave only 4 is because they don't keep the medical history of the patients, no name, no phone number, no treatment given, so every time is so annoying I have to repeat my previous treatment and my pains.  after a while I'm questioning their ability to treat patients on the long term or post traumatic events.
that said, I've been there for a minor lumbar spine pain, the therapist found out immediately the location of the pain and the reason for it. ultrasounds, manipulations, tractions to put the spine back to straight position. I'm overall satisfied with the treatment because the pain is totally gone. cost 600B.  but I emphasize it was just a minor lumbar spine pain. for more trauma related pains, I'd not be sure if they're really able to follow the patient in a professional and efficient way.

Excellent, professional and prompt service. I had acute lower back pain and they treated me immediately, without an appointment. I was in extreme discomfort and they were able to help me straight away and put me on the correct program for recovery.
